command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=${CONDA_PREFIX:-/opt/conda}/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
python3 -u fetch.py /tmp/cohort 2>&1 | tee /tmp/fetch.log
rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
cp /tmp/fetch.log /tmp/cohort/fetch.log
ls -l /tmp/cohort
exit $rc
